subject: Graduate application now open!
body:
Ready to apply to graduate school for 2027?

VISIT US  <https://www.binghamton.edu/admissions/graduate/visit/>





Office of Graduate Recruitment and Admissions



APPLY TODAY  <https://www.binghamton.edu/admissions/graduate/apply/>






                                Dear Anwar,

We are pleased to announce that the Binghamton University graduate application is now open for the spring, summer and fall 2027 semesters. 

                                The online application process is straightforward and only takes a few minutes to complete. Just provide your information, submit the required documents and pay the application fee, all in one streamlined system.                              

                                For a complete list of required documents, please visit our website <https://www.binghamton.edu/admissions/graduate/apply/admission-requirements.html>.                              

                                If you have any issues or questions during the application process, please feel free to reach out to the Office of Graduate Recruitment and Admissions.                              

                                Happy applying!                              

Office of Graduate Recruitment and Admissions
                                Binghamton University
                                State University of New York                              



APPLY NOW <http://gograd.binghamton.edu/apply/>





                              Office of Graduate Recruitment and Admissions
                              CALL US: 607-777-2151 <tel:+16077772151> | EMAIL US: gradadmission@binghamton.edu
